messages:
maya: FYI bringing up Aureion-7B-hybrid on int4 today, saw a weird divergence vs fp16 on TriviaQA.
sam: Nice. Is this the head-concat variant we discussed? any model-conversion steps we should watch for?
maya: yes head-concat. Conversion used our usual hf->redwood script, but I had to manually remap the head order because of legacy packing.
leo: quick note: head-concat often flips head ordering relative to Gemma-style layouts. Could cause KV-cache misalignment.
ciara: observed symptoms?
maya: short answers: exact-match drops ~6% on our eval set after quant, logits look shifted for many tokens. Longform seems ok.
sam: can you paste the repro command and the minimal log lines?
maya: 
```
./redwood_convert --src aureion-7b-hybrid --dst redwood-fmt --remap-heads mapping_v2.json
python -m redwood.eval --model ./converted --quant int4 --tasks triviaqa --batch 8
```
logs: "init head dims 128 -> found head order 0,2,1,3 in weights; runtime expects 0,1,2,3" then lots of "kvcache miss" traces.
leo: that head-order warning is classic. mapping_v2.json probably used old concat layout. Try head-swap map we used for orpheus-lite.
ciara: can we test a cheap fallback: run the same converted model but with a tiny runtime shim that permutes heads at runtime (no re-export)?
sam: I have a shim script for that. Also run bench-bot eval to get standardized metrics.
bench-bot: run queued: pr-1703/aureion-int4-shim
bench-bot: results ready — EM: fp16=0.48, int4(orig)=0.42, int4(shim)=0.47, latency +3% for shim
maya: wow shim recovered most of the drop. So it's definitely layout/ordering.
leo: confirms it's not quantization per se but packing/order mismatch. We should add a conversion check that validates head ordering vs runtime expectation.
ciara: agreed. maybe add a fast checksum in redwood_convert: verify head offsets and emit warning+fail if mismatch.
sam: filing a tiny ticket and a conversion test. maya can you attach the problematic checkpoint and mapping?
maya: uploading to /redwood/internal/aureion-onboard/1708001111, mapping file attached. I'll also push a failing unit test to conversion CI.
leo: after that, re-run full int4 sweep with the shim removed. If results stay near fp16, we can onboard.
ciara: one more thought — could tokenization play a role? did vocab mapping change between hf and our tokenizer?
maya: I sanity-checked token IDs for a handful of prompts, they align. This looks orthogonal.
sam: thanks team. Action items: (1) add conversion head-order check (sam), (2) merge maya's unit test + repro (maya), (3) run full int4 sweep post-fix (leo). I'll follow up in PR thread. :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks — will loop back with final numbers.
_meta: slack thread for eng-ml, on model onboarding/quant smoke for head-order mismatch in new hybrid model
